//: Durion drift guardrail. Layer onto your existing stylelint config (extends/rules) or use standalone. Run: npx stylelint "src/**/*.css"

selector-disallowed-list.message: Use the .dur-* utility prefix, not .mic-* (mic- is upstream-template drift). See design/source/durion-style-guide.md §05.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Unsanctioned or undefined token. Use a documented Durion token (design/source/theme-tokens.md): --space-* not --spacing-* (and no --space-5); --brand-primary / --cardBackground / --currentTextColor not Material-3 names like --color-primary or --surface-container-*; --goldA400 not raw #cc9030; Barlow Semi Condensed not 'Michelin Unit Titling'.
